programme.title: Andromeda: Ridderen, døden og djævelen
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at befri en flåde af tilfangetagne skibe, men flåden er ikke sikker på, at den ønsker at blive befriet. Deres AI'er frygter, at nye kaptajner vil gøre dem til slaver.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ubesmittet opfattelse
programme.desc: Genitter angriber Tyrs kone og koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tunnelen for enden af lyset
programme.desc: Med halvtreds parter om bord er Dylan vært for underskrivelsen af det nye rigsfællesskabs charter, men opdager snart, at der er ubudne gæster, der har til hensigt at stoppe underskrivelsen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvis hjulet er fastgjort
programme.desc: Beka og Tyr bliver overtaget af energien fra en dimensionstunnel. Dylan, Trance og Harper må redde dem, før de ødelægger skibet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skår
programme.desc: Dylan bliver anklaget for mord og skal rense sit navn, mens han finder delene af en vase, der siges at give ejeren "kosmos velsignelser

programme.title: Andromeda: Gal for at blive reddet
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en gruppe flygtninge, men opdager, at de har været udsat for regeringens eksperimenter og er ekstremt ustabile.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Beka's onkel stiller op til et embede i det nye Commonwealth, men et mordforsøg får besætningen til at agere som hans sikkerhed.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det ensomme og jævne sand
programme.desc: Da Andromeda bliver angrebet af pirater i rummet, bliver de reddet af et længe forsvundet rumskib fra Jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Krigshundene Slipfighter
programme.desc: Besætningen opdager, at en slyngelplanet, Marduk, har fremstillet masseødelæggelsesvåben.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den spedalskes kys
programme.desc: En lejemorder ved navn Leper er ude efter lederne af det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver hjemsøgt af et mystisk væsen, der kommer om bord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Andromeda: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programme.desc: Da en længe savnet kærlighed vender tilbage, forsvinder Tyr fra skibet for at beskytte hende mod en lejemorder.
programme.sub-title: And Your Heart Will Fly Away

programme.title: Andromeda: Den uovervindelige mand
programme.desc: Spiller i et alternativt univers, hvor Dylan er død, og Gaheris Rhade forsøger at reformere Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Den gruppe, der angreb Andromeda under den første underskrivelse af Commonwealth-charter, vender tilbage for at skabe mere ravage.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det mørke bagud
programme.desc: Trance gennemgår nogle forskellige scenarier og forsøger at finde et, hvor hendes besætningsmedlemmer ikke dør.

programme.title: Andromeda: Risiko-alt-punktet
programme.desc: Et kraftigere Andromeda skib eksploderer sandsynligvis på grund af sabotage, hvilket tvinger Dylans besætning til at redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den rigtige hest
programme.desc: Beka bringer både sin besætning og en hel planet i fare, da en tidligere kærlighed dukker op.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvad sker der med en udskudt rev?
programme.desc: Andromeda modtager et råb om hjælp fra Rev Bam.
programme.sub-title: Hvad sker der med en udskudt rev?

programme.title: Andromeda: Spidsen af spyddet
programme.desc: Efter at en planet i Commonwealth bliver angrebet af pyroformere fra Pyrian, er Dylan tvunget til at kæmpe for at beskytte den nye planet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Himlens hvælving
programme.desc: Dylan hører stemmer, der lokker ham til en planet med "ild og is".

programme.title: Andromeda: Deep Midnight's Voice
programme.desc: Mens besætningen er fanget i en kamp mellem to nietzscheanske stolthedspunkter, fanger besætningen en fjendtlig person, der hævder, at hans stolthed har et kort over slipstrømmen

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bump in the Night
programme.desc: When a victim is brutally murdered in his own bed, investigators find a shoe impression in the mud outside — physical evidence they hope will lead to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Searching
programme.desc: Armed with little else, police hoped that shoe impressions found at a Lansing, Michigan crime scene would put their investigation of Audrey Nichols' murder back on track.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: High 'n Dry
programme.desc: When Genell Plude is found dead in her bathroom, the scene points to suicide. But a coroner's inquest and a unique application of forensic science give investigators a different explanation for her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: To the Viktor
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wired for Disaster
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wood-be Killer
programme.desc: A killer tries to incinerate everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently creates new forensic evidence. Detectives employ a technique never before used in a criminal investigation to bring it to light.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naughty or Nyce
programme.desc: A woman appears to have lost control of her SUV and plunged down an embankment into a shallow creek. But investigators suspect foul play when they find snowy footprints leading away from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Going for Broke
programme.desc: When a successful stockbroker doesn't return home after a late shift, his wife reports him missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Just Desserts
programme.desc: The prime suspect had a criminal record and his driver's license was found at the scene of a brutal double homicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday's Wake
programme.desc: When a little girl got sick and died, investigators were stumped. Was it an accident, an unexplained illness or murder?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Dreams
programme.desc: When a car was found in a drainage ditch with two bodies inside, a fingertip torn from a latex glove would point investigators to both the crime scene and the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dockter Visit
programme.desc: An investigation into the murder of a World War II veteran slowed to a halt when the prime suspect had a solid alibi. But a lucky break led to a shady character who wore distinctive boots and had a sweet tooth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: A woman who was known to have suffered from depression apparently took her own life. But her sister told police that, a year before her death, she said if anything were to happen to her there would be a note in the china cabinet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Concrete Alibi
programme.desc: An aspiring model turned up dead and the prime suspect was her boyfriend. When he was eventually cleared, investigators had to dig deeper to find the perpetrator. With the help of a forensic geologist, they identified the most unlikely suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Key Evidence
programme.desc: When an off-duty policeman was shot dead, his fellow officers were determined to solve the crime. They needed clues to find the killer and they discovered them in tiny fibres and an asthma inhaler.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Gambler
programme.desc: One warm summer afternoon, the town of Verona, Wisconsin faced its first triple homicide. To solve the case, investigators had to delve into the world of high rollers and offshore betting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Weakest Link
programme.desc: The body of a young girl was discovered on isolated farmland near Delano, California. She had no ID, but police found mailbox keys in the pocket of her jeans. With no other clues, they checked the mailboxes of every apartment building in Delano.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Capitol Crimes
programme.desc: The driver said he couldn't have hit and killed a pedestrian on a Harrisburg street. The Jeep Grand Cherokee he was leasing around that time had been sold months ago to a buyer in another state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Undertaken
programme.desc: The medical examiner ruled the death an accident, but the detectives investigating the case thought the evidence at the scene indicated otherwise.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dark Waters
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run boating accident caused the death of a popular young man, investigators faced the daunting task of searching for one boat among 1200 others.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nice Threads
programme.desc: A woman was found dead on the bedroom floor of her apartment. The crime scene yielded little of value and investigators wondered if they would find enough evidence to make a case, much less catch a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grave Danger
programme.desc: A young man was killed in a mysterious car crash, but the evidence at the scene led investigators to believe it was not an accident. Forensic science revealed what really happened and the truth devastated three families.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Internal Affair
programme.desc: When a woman went missing, friends and family were determined to find her. Their worst fears were confirmed weeks later when her body was discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Case of the Flue
programme.desc: In 1993, 82-year-old Kathryn Bishop was found dead in her Pennsylvania home. Tiny clues on the victim's body would tell police what happened that night.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Critical Evidence
programme.desc: To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lasting Impressions
programme.desc: No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: IFISH: Mulloway - Botany Bay, NSW
programme.desc: Ever wondered why Captain Cook chose to first land on the southern banks of Botany Bay on Sunday 29th April 1770? Because the fishing is so hot! The fish were coming in so thick and fast the boys had to take a break...

programme.title: Anglers Digest: St. Lucia
programme.desc: You’ll join us on an informative island tour of volcanoes, waterfalls, gardens, and scenic viewpoints, and even get a chance to party with the friendly natives that are lucky enough to call this paradise their home.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Curaçao
programme.desc: This episode includes a great island tour where you’ll explore the island history, the natural scenic splendors, and a city tour of Willemstad, all of which will make you strongly consider a trip here in the future.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Grand Cayman
programme.desc: IGFA Anglers Digest returns to Grand Cayman to fish and dive in this secluded piece of paradise. Known the world over for its world class scuba diving, those who really know the island come to fish as well.

programme.desc: Having never been to these amazing Caribbean jewels, I can now see what everyone has raved about the last several years.

programme.desc: Leaving the hustle and bustle of Cabo we land in a neighboring city that houses the amazing new Puerto Los Cabo Marina. San Jose Del Cabo has some of the finest fishing in all of Baja located just outside the marina entrance.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Cabo San Lucas
programme.desc: Not much has to be said about Land’s End at the tip of the Baja Peninsula to make you want to crave a trip there.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: East Cape
programme.desc: On the last episode of our Los Cabos TRIFECTA we enjoy the serenity of the Buena Vista Beach Resort and the fishing found from it.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: San Diego 1
programme.desc: Never a dull moment in my old stomping grounds, San Diego is one of my favorite cities in America and for good reason, great weather, great food, great military heritage, and awesome fishing.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: San Diego 2
programme.desc: Never a dull moment in my old stomping grounds, San Diego is one of my favorite cities in America and for good reason, great weather, great food, great military heritage, and awesome fishing.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Alaska
programme.desc: Our love of Alaska, “America’s Africa” is continued this season joining Mike Briggs as he hosts us at the Clover Pass Resort near Ketchikan, in beautiful Southeast Alaska.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Islamorada
programme.desc: Plenty has been written, photographed, and filmed about the Florida Keys, and the epicenter of fishing activity that surrounds them.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Fiji
programme.desc: The South Pacific, a place so endearing in terms of the people, the fishing, and the diving, no place in the region can compare to Matava Resort on Kadavu Island.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Lindberghs Reindeer Lake Pike

programme.title: The Hills: Everyone Falls
programme.desc: Med udsigt til et nyt job, falder Whitney over sin største mulighed med Teen Vogue. Spencer går for vidt, da han presser Heidi til at forlade Lauren og flytte ind med ham.

programme.title: The Hills: Goodbye for Now
programme.desc: I sæsonfinalen tilspidses tingene, da Heidi beslutter at flytte ind med Spencer. Lauren vil have Audrina til at fylde tomrummet efter hendes bedste veninde, og Whitney flyver til New York til et interview.

programme.title: The Hills: You Know What You Did
programme.desc: Lauren går ikke til Heidi and Spencers housewarming fordi Heidi har spredt rygter om hende. Så da Lauren løber ind i Heidi har de et kæmpe skænderi.

programme.title: The Hills: Big Girls Don't Cry
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi bliver endnu mere uvenner da Spencer frier til Heidi. Audrina finder sammen med en ekskæreste og Lauren vender hjem til Laguna Beach for at få et godt råd.

programme.title: The Hills: Truth And Time Tells All
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at hjælpe Audrina med at beslutte om Justin har kærestekvalitet, men Audrina har allerede truffet sin beslutning. Heidi finder ud af, at det ikke er lutter lagkage at være forlovet.

programme.title: The Hills: Meet The Parents
programme.desc: Ifølge mig: et komisk twist på din yndlings reality-serie. Fra Lauren til Spencer og alle de andre, intet bitchy look eller bromance udelades af skuespilleren, der spilleralle de medvirkende.

programme.title: The Hills: Rolling With The Enemy
programme.desc: Heidis sociale omgangskreds krymper da Spencer 'slår op' med Brody fordi han har hængt ud med Lauren. Audrina vil være fast kæreste med Justin, men det nægter han at gå med til.

programme.title: The Hills: Second Chances
programme.desc: Lauren bliver ringet op af en ekskæreste. Heidi konkurrerer med sin kollega Elodie om at blive forfremmet på arbejdet.

programme.title: The Hills: They Meet Again
programme.desc: Laurens følelser for Jason blusser op, men da de løber ind i Heidi og Spencer på en restaurant går bølgerne højt. Heidis forfremmelse hos Bolthouse koster hendes venskab med Elodie.

programme.title: The Hills: For Better Or Worse
programme.desc: Lauren bliver chokeret da hun hører, at Jason har en kæreste, men Jason har en endnu større overraskelse oppe i ærmet. Heidi finder ud af at Spencer ikke har fortalt sine forældre om deres bryllupsplaner.

programme.title: The Hills: What Happens In Vegas...
programme.desc: Hele slænget fejrer Brodys fødselsdag i Vegas. Audrinas kæreste Justin skaber splid i venskabet med Lauren. Lauren og Brodys tiltrækkes mere og mere af hinanden.

programme.title: The Hills: What Goes Around
programme.desc: Jen Bunney fortæller Lauren, at Brody startede rygterne om hende, mens Brody siger, at det var Spencer, hvilket bringer Heidi i en svær situation.

programme.title: The Hills: No More Mr. Nice Guy
programme.desc: Lauren indleder et nyt forhold med en model, men indser, at hun stadig har følelser for Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Stress And The City
programme.desc: Whitney og Lauren tager en tur til New York NYC for Teen Vogue og Spencer kontakter Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Young Hollywood
programme.desc: Whitney og Lauren er til Young Hollywood Party og Heidi fejrer sin 21. fødselsdag.

programme.title: The Hills: Forgive and Forget
programme.desc: Heidi og Lauren skændes endnu engang offentligt, hvilket får Heidi til at undskylde for alt det, der er sket. Og der er problemer i Audrina og Justins forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: With This Ring...
programme.desc: Lauren leger Kirsten Giftekniv, da Whitney skal ud på sin første date med deres personlige træner. Og Spencer modsætter sig Heidis ønsker om et eventyrbryllup.

programme.title: The Hills: A Night At The Opera
programme.desc: Audrina ser Justin kysse med en anden pige, hvilket fører til endnu et kæmpeskænderi. Heidi er chokeret, da Stephanie skændes med Lauren og Brody på en natklub.

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player
programme.desc: Lauren tror, at Brody måske er for meget playboy for hende. Spencers søster fortæller hende, at Heidi er i tvivl om deres bryllup.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får en god nyhed til Teen Vogue og Heidi har brug for noget tid væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer endelig af sted til Paris, men turen bliver næsten ødelagt da hun finder ud af, at Brody har fundet en anden. Spencer følger Heidi til Colorado for at prøve at vinde hende tilbage, men hans plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney må vælge mellem Teen Vogue og risikoen forbundet med at gå efter en ny karriere. Lauren og Brody skændes over hans nye kæreste og Heidi vænner sig til livet uden Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en uventet ven, da Spencers søster, Stephanie, går til de samme timer som hende. Whitney tror, at hendes nye job vil opfylde alle hendes drømme.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: Da Lauren inviterer Stephanie til hendes fødselsdag, får det Heidi og Spencer til at tvivle på Stephanies loyalitet. Spencer forsøger at vinde Heidi tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...
programme.desc: Heidi prøver at vinde Audrinas venskab tilbage, men Lauren tvivler på Heidis motiver. Whitney er ved at vænne sig til sit nye job, men savner stadig at arbejde sammen med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Heidi elsker at være single, men da hun ser Spencer sammen med andre piger bliver hun jaloux. Whitney beder om Laurens hjælp til modeugen i LA.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate
programme.desc: Med Spencer ude af billedet, gør Heidi et sidste forsøg på at blive gode venner med Lauren igen. Da Audrina begynder at tilbringe mere tid med Heidi og Justin, overvejer Lauren, om de bør blive ved med at bo sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: Gammel kærlighed blusser op da Stephen Coletti dukker op i Laurens liv igen. Heidi prøver at sørge for, at Stephanie ikke kommer til Laurens housewarming.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren har svært ved at vælge side, da problemerne mellem Lo og Audrina eskalerer. Og Heidi tager et job, der vil tage hende til Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit føler Audrina sig lukket ude af Laurens venskab med Lo, og hun overvejer at flytte ud. Lauren gør et sidste forsøg på at blive god venner med Audrina, men måske er det for sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: Da sæson fire starter er situationen mellem Audrina og Lo anspændt. Lauren forsøger at gøre et godt indtryk på en ny fyr, og et besøg fra Heidis søster Holly truer Spencer og Heidis forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie bliver uvenner med sin bror og hans ven da Lauren møder Spencer på sin fødselsdag. Kelly Cutrone fyrer en fra People's Revolution og Whitney overtager stillingen. Laurens forhold til Doug udvikler sig lidt for hurtigt.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren indser at den kemi, hun havde med Doug på studiet ikke længere er der. Whitney er nervøs for at tage til New York, men en date med en model gør hende gladere. Til trods for forsoningsgestusen vil Spencer bryde helt med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En vild tur til Las Vegas går galt, da Audrina ignorerer Lauren. Brody nævner Stephanies fortid, og drengene ryger i brummen. Heidis søster Holly flytter ind, men det er intet Spencer hellere vil end at smide hende ud.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kæmper for at redde deres venskab, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fået nok af Heidis søster Holly og tager sagen i egne hænder. Og Brody og Doug forlader fængslet med nye historier.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis søster Holly tager kontakt med Lauren, noget som tvinger både Lauren og Heidi til at revurdere hvad der er sket med dere venskab.. Audrina og Justins forhold bliver sat på prøve, da hun arbejder på en event for Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: Da Lauren tager på ferie med familien, går alting galt i Los Angeles. Stephanie dater Doug bag Laurens rygg, og Audrina og Heidi bliver venner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sandheden om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer frem, da de alle mødes til Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøg til LA og ryger ud i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi, hvor hun beklager og indser, at der kun er én ting, som forhindrer dem i at blive venner igen. Audrina starter med at date en ny fyr for at gøre Justin jaloux, men hendes plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møder sin gamle flamme Corey igen og jonglerer pludselig to fyre. Spencer tvinger Heidi til at smide sin søster Holly ud af lejligheden.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina rejser til Cabo til Brody fødselsdag, men da Justin bliver jaloux på Audrinas nye forhold, udvikler festen sig til en slåskamp. Spencer ydmyger Stephanie da hun finder ud af, at hendes nye kæreste er ven med Brody.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Being Shady 101
programme.desc: Den 10. single ankommer til villaen og lander midt i en kærlighedstrekant. Farrah provokerer sine bofæller. En eks spreder et ondt rygte, når sårede følelser giver sig udtryk i hævn.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Simon Says
programme.desc: Farrah får en stor overraskelse i Hemmelighedshulen. En eks af en eks dukker op og laver ravage i et spirende forhold og afslører nogle løgne. Den første eks bliver sendt hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Worst Date Ever
programme.desc: To ekser går ssammen for at vælte Maya og hendes slæng. En uventet overraskelse bringer et af husets stærkeste par i fare.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Jay Is For Jealous
programme.desc: Huset fejrer Farrahs tilbagevenden. Jalousi starter en fysisk konfrontation, da en intim sandhed bliver afsløret. Noget uventet sker ved eliminering.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Low Blows
programme.desc: En forventet eks-ankomst starter et ordentligt skænderi, da ulmende spændinger omsider eksploderer. Farrah blander sig i andres sager og gør huset mere kaotisk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Revenge is Sweet
programme.desc: Handlinger har konsekvenser, da ekserne hører om de slemme ting, som singlerne har sagt om dem. Jays usikkerhed om Morgans ekser når kogepunktet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Here Comes Trouble
programme.desc: Et ustabilt forhold bliver turbulent da Angela vender tilbage til stranden for at lave ravage og stjæle nogle mænd. Huset flipper ud, da en fest kører af sporet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Un-Bear-Able
programme.desc: Sandheden om Murrays skumle fortid bliver blotlagt. Det stærkeste par i huset konfronterer sit første eks-problem. Janelle lærer konsekvenserne af sine handlinger.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: How to Keep a Man 101
programme.desc: Chad og Nicoles situation forværres da endnu en eks ankommer. En fest i huset får endnu en deltager til at bryde sammen i jalousi.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ghost of Relationship's Past
programme.desc: Nicoles jalousi får frit afløb da Maddie siger nogle urimelige ting.Et fortidsspøgelse dukker op for at søge hævn.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Bad Bromance
programme.desc: Angelas værste mareridt går i opfyldelse da en eks dukker op på stranden. Chad skal forholde sig til konsekvenserne af Nicoles handlinger. Et skænderi truer med at afslutte den største bromance i huset.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex-Viction Notice
programme.desc: Hemmelighedshullet slår til, da Angela bliver sat i den varme stol, og Nurys skal træffe en vigtig beslutning. Ekserne mødes med en overraskende eliminering.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex, Lies, and Polygraph Tape
programme.desc: Farrah vender tilbage for at finde ud af, om hun er kommet sig helt over sin eks. Sandheden afsløres, da alle i huset tvinges til at evaluere deres forhold baseret på en løgnedetektortest.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 1
programme.desc: Efter en turbulent sæson genforenes singlerne og ekserne for første gang for at tale om sæsonens største forhold, splittelser og forræderi. De afslører, om de stadig er forelskede eller er gået fra hinanden siden sæsonen sluttede.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 2
programme.desc: Dramaet fortsætter i anden del af Ex on the Beach Reunion, da løgnedetektoren tvinger Morgan til at indrømme sandheden, et nyt forhold afsløres og utroskab afdækkes.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Welcome to the Peak
programme.desc: 10 reality-kendisser tager til et vinterlandskab for at se, om de kan finde deres næste udkårne, men de ved ikke, at deres ekser vil komme stormende som en lavine.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Winter Un-Wonderland
programme.desc: Callum og Nicoles ekser skaber store problemer. En forbindelse bliver skabt og hurtigt brudt igen. En ny eks kommer, og den første hotte date bliver belønnet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Caught Red Velvet Handed
programme.desc: Daniel gør et akavet forsøg på at skabe en forbindelse. Det går hedt for sig i Hemmelighedssaunaen for en lumsk single. Den første eks bliver frosset ude.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: De Niall Is Not Just an Ex
programme.desc: Marlon får opmærksomhed fra flere ekser, og det er Adore ikke glad for. En charmerende overraskelse afbryder den hotte date.
programme.sub-title: De Niall Is Not Just an Ex

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Boo Years Eve!
programme.desc: Hemmelighedssaunaen åbenbarer et mysterium for Marlond eks. To singler kæmper om den samme eks. Bølgerne går højt til isceremonien, når en eks foretager et overraskende træk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: The Bird Has Landed
programme.desc: Georgia og Callums forhold bliver sat på prøve, da den eks, de frygtede mest, dukker op. Bølgerne går højt over La Demis seneste flamme. En romantisk hot date bliver belønnet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: SOS, Save Our Singles
programme.desc: En chokerende Hemmelighedssauna betyder, at singlerne må være på vagt ved isceremonien. Allie og Nialls ustabile forhold gør Allie usikker.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Wants And Needs
programme.desc: En afsløring i Sandhedsbåsen ryster huset og efterlader et par i en akavet kærlighedstrekant. Et andet par må afslutte deres forhold, da presset fra huset begynder at tynge dem.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Da singlerne slår sig løs til en fest, truer jalousi med at afholde et par fra at tage på deres feriedate. Der opstår frustration da huset indser, at kun et af deres stærkeste par kan være et perfekt match.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Surprise-gæster giver singlerne råd og indsigt i, hvad der skal til for at finde deres perfekte match. En afsløring i Sandhedsbåsen ændrer dynamikken i huset.
programme.sub-title: It Takes One To Know One

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: I et hidtil uset øjeblik afslører Kamie et perfekt match ved match up-ceremonien. Et yndlingspar lærer endelig deres skæbne at kende. Et andet par fortryder deres brud.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Will skal leve med konsekvenserne af at forsøge at holde fast i sit forhold til Courtney, mens han leder efter sit perfekte match. Huset slår sig løs og deler skjulte talenter.

programme.title: Are You The One?: You Were The One
programme.desc: Efter ugers diskussion med hinanden om, hvordan man finder en match, slår singlerne sig sammen og sætter mere på spil end nogensinde for at finde ægte kærlighed.

programme.title: Are You The One?: You Can't Handle the Truth
programme.desc: Ti singlepiger og ti singlefyre skal tilbringe en måned sammen mens de finder ud af, hvem som passer sammen. Klarer de det, kan de dele det største præmiebeløb i MTV\s historie - en million dollar.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Temptation of Chris T
programme.desc: Chris T satser hele prisen på en million dollar eftersom han ikke kan give slip på Shanley, og da Ryans dagbøger forsvinder søger han trøst hos Kayla - der selv søger trøst hos Wes.

programme.title: Are You The One?: A Real 'G'
programme.desc: Situationen er spændt mellem Jacy og Simone, der kæmper om Johns gunst. Og det hotter op mellem Brittany og Adam, der tager en tur i boom-boom-rummet , og i udfordringen afslører pigerne pinlige ting om sig selv.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Karma's a Bitch
programme.desc: I udfordringen afslører fyrenes ekser ting og sager og overnatter i huset. Brittany har svært ved at acceptere, at Adam ikke er interesseret. Og Coleysia og Ashleigh tænder op under romantikken.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Double Shot
programme.desc: Situationen er spændt mellem John og Simone. Kayla bliver interesseret i Wes igen, men hun holder stasig fast i Ryan. Humøret stiger, da de kan sende to par i sandhedsboksen efter udfordringen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Turn The Paige
programme.desc: Alle præver at regne ud, hvem der er det perfekte par. Kayla bliver afsløret, da hun spiller Ryan ud mod Wes, og Simone prøver at splitte Chris T og Shanley. Et besøg i sandhedsboksen vender op og ned på alt i huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It's So Hard...To Say Goodbye
programme.desc: Huset er rystet, da Paige og Chris T bliver bekræftet som det perfekte par og sendes til Bryllupssuiten. Shanley er totalt knust efter at være blevet skilt fra Chris T, og Kayla flipper ud, da Ryan vil trøste Jessica.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Getting Dumped On
programme.desc: Kayla og Ryan skændes, men huset vender sig mod Kayla, da hun afslører følsomme oplysninger, der truer Ambers forhold til Ethan. En slibrig udfordring tester nogle af parrenes evne til at holde sammen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: White Party
programme.desc: Til hvid fest har alle i huset det sjovt, men John må forholde sig til Jacys følelser for Scali. I en udfordring på stranden får parrene sand under neglene.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Rub Down With A Happy Ending
programme.desc: Huset forsøger at regne ud, hvordan de finder deres perfekte match og vinder en million dollars. Jacy ser sine følelser for Scali og John i øjnene, da huset forsøger at løse den sidste kærlighedstrekant.
programme.sub-title: Rub Down With A Happy Ending

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion Special
programme.desc: Alle de tyve deltagere bliver genforenet med Ryan Devlin for at diskutere, hvad der skete på Hawaii, og vi viser ikke tidligere vist materiale, chokerende afsløringer og sladder om parrene som fortsat er sammen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Are You The One? Special Delivery
programme.desc: Deltagerne i første sæson genforenes til den største begivenhed i Ethans og Ambers liv - en baby! Find ud af, hvordan det er gået med deltagerne, mens de tilbringer en vild weekend sammen for at fejre babyen med et AYTO-gave.
programme.sub-title: Are You The One? Special Delivery

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Too Many
programme.desc: 10 perfekt sammensatte fyre og piger får et chok, når de finder ud af, det bliver sværere at finde 10 par, for der er 11 piger. Paris og Pratt prøver at undgå den første sandhedsbås.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Truth Will Cost You
programme.desc: Teamet bliver spændt, da både Layton og Shelby havner i kærlighedstrekanter. Fyrene graver ting op om pigerne i en konkurrence, som kan sende den ellevte pige i sandhedsbåsen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Virgin Tears
programme.desc: Der er tårer, da Shelby afslutter sin kærlighedstrekant. John prøver at nærme sig Christina, men bliver blokeret af Brandon, hendes ikke-match. Teamet bliver chokeret da de hører, at der er en jomfru blandt dem.
